❓ Frequently asked questions

What do the Beaufort numbers mean?

The Beaufort scale runs 0–12: 0 calm, 1–3 light-to-gentle breezes, 4–5 moderate-to-fresh, 6–7 strong-to-near-gale, 8–9 gale, 10 storm, 11 violent storm, 12 hurricane force.

At what speed is it hurricane force?

Force 12 begins at 118 km/h (73 mph / 64 knots). A tropical cyclone is classed as hurricane force on the Beaufort scale from that speed.

How do knots convert to km/h?

1 knot = 1.852 km/h exactly (one nautical mile per hour). 1 m/s = 3.6 km/h exactly.
